stemMarkdown: In a class, 20 boys have an average score of 52 and 15 girls have an average score of 43. What is the average score of the whole class? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total score $= 20 \times 52 + 15 \times 43 = 1685$ across $35$ students, so the average is $\dfrac{1685}{35} = 48.14$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The combined average must lie between 43 and 52, closer to whichever group is larger — a useful sanity check before computing.
